references.name: entrance-oblique
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary oblique entrance photograph. Broad metal roof with a deep cantilever, gently bowed underside and raised edges; slim tall rounded external pillars with capital/beam attachments. Recessed glass upper entrance and long facade bands sit below a dark grey metal fascia. Roof underside has parallel panel seams/ribs. Roof gold tone is warm sunlight, not evidence of gold material. No copied lettering/signs/brands.

references.name: station-overview
references.observed: Actually inspected ordinary aerial nighttime overview. Complete broad blue-lit rectangular roof with subtle long seams and shaped/folded short edges; recessed upper glazing and low opaque band; both end/side entry fronts; tall external supports; broad shallow entrance stair flights. Low long canopy/covered walk runs beside the bus bays. Neighboring tower/mall/bus/taxi context is independent. Blue roof is nighttime lighting, not a daytime blue paint observation.

note: Two adequate ordinary pictures inspected. Current standard PMTiles supplies metric plans, stacked heights and columns. Exact hidden thresholds, underground/platform layout, current works and fine rib inventory remain approximate. No more artifact-specific research.
